knownUnsupported.description: Ephemeral boxes do not support preview URLs.

evidence.contains: Preview URLs are not supported on ephemeral boxes. Use ephemeral: false to create a full box with preview support.

knownUnsupported.description: Direct template creation is unsupported; snapshots are the documented alternative.

evidence.contains: Upstash Box does not support template creation directly. Use snapshot.create() to save a box state, then Box.fromSnapshot() to restore from it.
